name: What is the process for getting my gate repaired by Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting my gate repaired by Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our gate repair process begins with a service request, followed by a scheduled assessment of your gate. We then provide a detailed estimate outlining the necessary repairs and associated costs. Once approved, our team performs the repair using quality materials. We aim for efficient service with minimal disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our gate repair process involves a service request, assessment, detailed estimate, and efficient repair by our team.
